romeo-y-julieta-cuba--linea-clasica.description: The core range of Romeo y Julieta, a Habanos brand registered in 1873 and made from Vuelta Abajo tobacco. Medium in strength, it spans a wide set of shapes, from the small Petit Julietas and Mille Fleurs to the Churchills and Belicosos and the cedar-wrapped Cedros de Luxe.

thirds.notes: A gentle opening of cedar and honeyed sweetness, with light coffee, nutty hints and pepper that builds slowly.
Sweetness deepens and the smoke turns creamy, with cocoa, dry leather and a floral lift.
The sweetness recedes for dry cedar, leather and coffee, with more spice and a firmer grip near the end.

romeo-y-julieta-cuba--linea-de-oro.description: A newer Romeo y Julieta range of three sizes, Dianas, Hidalgos and Nobles, announced in 2020 and reaching shops in late 2021. Made in Cuba from Vuelta Abajo tobacco, it is listed as medium to full in strength, a step up from the medium classic line.

thirds.notes: A creamy start of fine wood and cedar, lifted by white pepper and a touch of roasted coffee.
Leather, walnut and a little chocolate join in, and the pepper lingers as the strength steps up.
Leather leads a bolder finish, with warm baking spice, pepper and roasted nuts.

romeo-y-julieta-cuba--stopgezette-vitola.description: Romeo y Julieta sizes that Habanos has withdrawn over the years, from older shapes dropped in 1980 or earlier to Coronas and Petit Princess in 2012, Exhibición No. 3 in 2013 and Cedros de Luxe No. 1 in 2017. Most other historic sizes, such as Julietas and Clemenceaus, left the range earlier still.

romeo-y-julieta-cuba--edicion-limitada.description: Annual Edición Limitada releases of Romeo y Julieta, made in Cuba in limited runs and marked by a separate Edición Limitada band. Past editions include Escudos (2007), Dukes (2009), Capuleto (2013), Capuletos Sobresalientes (2016) and Tacos Imperiales (2018).

sources.title: Cuban Cigar Website – Romeo y Julieta

romeo-y-julieta-cuba--reserva-en-gran-re.description: Small Romeo y Julieta releases made from tobacco of a single harvest that rested for years before rolling. The Churchill Reserva from the 2008 harvest and the Gran Reserva from the 2009 harvest were each limited to 5,000 boxes, and a Robustos Reserva from the 2019 harvest followed.

sources.title: Cuban Cigar Website – Romeo y Julieta

romeo-y-julieta-cuba--coleccion-habanos-.description: One-off Romeo y Julieta releases outside the regular range, from the Double Corona of 2000 and the Fabulosos of the Colección Habanos to the 109 of 2005 and the Grand Churchills of 2018. Others include aged Añejados editions of the Pirámides and Churchills, all made in Cuba in small numbers.
